ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio; approximately 65% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels dominating the medial and central regions, versus 35% high-intensity (white/mottled) pixels localized at the lateral distal extremities.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large, irregular high-intensity mottled patches located on the far left and far right lobes; central region is a solid low-intensity block interspersed with discrete, high-intensity circular punctate marks (scars) ranging from 5 to 25 pixels in diameter.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated aperture of approximately 52 degrees and a deep, narrow vertex transition.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire boundary; amplitude of peaks increases significantly towards the distal tips, presenting a jagged, saw-tooth morphology.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lateral symmetrical sweep; initial convex curvature from the median notch transitioning into a broad concave curve towards the lateral terminals.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High density of circular high-contrast white spots concentrated in the medial dark zones; secondary clusters of yellowish-white circular formations along the upper margin of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct multi-directional linear pixel disruptions; three prominent parallel diagonal scratches on the mid-left lobe and several vertical micro-striations near the lower center.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive colonization of high-relief, roughly hemispherical barnacle clusters (Coronula diadema) clustered heavily on the leading and trailing edge intersections of both distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, thick low-intensity linear 'finger' of pigmentation extending vertically through the center of the right-side white mottled region.
